faqHome.title: Frequently Asking Questions
faqHome.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about Student Revelation System and how it can help manage your school district.
faqHome.q1: What user roles are available in the system?
faqHome.a1: The system supports multiple user roles including administrators, teachers, students, parents, and staff members. Each role has specific permissions and access levels tailored to their needs.
faqHome.q2: Can we ever have multiple roles?
faqHome.a2: Yes, users can be assigned multiple roles within the system. For example, a teacher can also be a parent or administrator, with access to all relevant features for each role.
faqHome.q3: What types of reports are available?
faqHome.a3: We offer attendance reports, grade reports, behavior reports, health risk lists, dropout risk analysis, and custom reports that can be scheduled or generated on-demand.
faqHome.q4: What security measures are in place?
faqHome.a4: Our system implements enterprise-grade security including data encryption, FERPA compliance, role-based access control, regular security audits, and secure data backup protocols.
faqHome.q5: Does the system integrate with other tools?
faqHome.a5: Yes, our system integrates with popular educational tools, learning management systems, student information systems, and third-party applications through our robust API.
faqHome.q6: Can we import existing student data?
faqHome.a6: Absolutely! We provide data migration services and support importing from various formats including CSV, Excel, and direct database transfers from existing systems.

about.title: About Us
about.intro: Student Revelation System (RMS) helps K–12 schools manage students, health, behavior, and communication in one place—so educators can focus on what matters most.
about.storyP1: We built RMS because we saw schools juggling spreadsheets, paper forms, and disconnected tools. Teachers, nurses, and admins needed one system that could handle attendance, grades, health records, discipline, and parent communication—without the complexity of enterprise software.
about.storyP2: Today, schools use RMS to keep student data secure, streamline daily operations, and give parents and teachers a clear view of each student's journey. We're committed to evolving with your needs and keeping the platform simple and reliable.
about.missionDesc: To empower schools with tools that simplify administration and improve outcomes for every student.
about.visionDesc: A world where educators spend less time on paperwork and more time supporting students and families.
about.studentCenteredDesc: Every feature we build puts student success and well-being at the center.
about.excellenceDesc: We support schools in delivering consistent, high-quality education and care.
about.partnershipDesc: We work alongside admins, teachers, nurses, and parents as one team.
about.integrityDesc: Schools trust us with sensitive data; we protect it and use it responsibly.
about.trustedDesc: Schools use RMS for attendance, grades, health records, nurse visits, behavior tracking, parent-teacher communication, and reporting—all in one secure platform.

roles.q1: What user roles are available in the system?
roles.a1: Our system supports multiple roles including Super Admin, School Admin, Teacher, Student, Parent, Nurse, and Counselor. Each role has specific permissions tailored to their responsibilities.
roles.q2: Can one user have multiple roles?
roles.a2: Yes, users can be assigned multiple roles. For example, a teacher can also be a parent within the system, accessing both portals with a single login.
roles.q3: How do I reset my password?
roles.a3: Click on "Forgot Password" on the login page. Enter your email address and you'll receive a password reset link. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.

parent.q1: What can parents access in the portal?
parent.a1: Parents can view their child's grades, attendance records, upcoming assignments, teacher messages, health records, and schedule. They can also communicate with teachers and receive real-time notifications.
parent.q2: How do students access their grades?
parent.a2: Students log into their portal using their credentials. The dashboard displays current grades, GPA, assignments, and detailed breakdowns for each class.
parent.a3: Yes, parents can send secure messages directly to teachers through the portal. They can also schedule parent-teacher conferences and receive notifications about their child's progress.

reports.q1: What types of reports are available?
reports.a1: We offer attendance reports, grade reports, behavior reports, health records, dropout risk analysis, honor roll reports, and custom reports that can be scheduled or generated on-demand.
reports.a2: Yes, all reports can be exported in multiple formats including PDF, Excel, and CSV. You can also schedule automatic report generation and delivery via email.
reports.a3: Our AI-powered analytics analyze historical data to identify at-risk students, predict academic performance trends, and provide early warning indicators for dropout risk.

security.a1: Yes, our system is fully FERPA compliant. We implement strict access controls, audit trails, and data protection measures to ensure student information privacy.
security.a2: Medical data is encrypted at rest and in transit, with HIPAA-compliant storage. Access is restricted to authorized personnel only (nurses, designated administrators) with full audit logging.
security.q3: What security measures are in place?
security.a3: We use 256-bit encryption, multi-factor authentication, role-based access control, regular security audits, SOC 2 Type II certification, and automatic security updates.

trial.q1: What's included in the free trial?
trial.a1: The 30-day free trial includes full access to all features, up to 100 student records, all portals (Parent, Student, Teacher, Admin), and email/chat support. No credit card required.
trial.a2: Pricing is based on the number of students in your district. We offer flexible annual and multi-year plans with volume discounts. Contact our sales team for a custom quote.
trial.a3: During the trial, you can cancel anytime with no obligations. For paid subscriptions, you can cancel with 30 days notice. We also offer a 60-day money-back guarantee.

integrations.q1: Does the system integrate with other tools?
integrations.a1: Yes, we integrate with popular tools including Google Classroom, Microsoft Teams, Canvas, PowerSchool, and various state reporting systems. We also offer a RESTful API for custom integrations.
integrations.q2: Can we import existing student data?
integrations.a2: Absolutely! We support CSV, Excel, and direct database imports. Our team provides data migration assistance to ensure a smooth transition from your current system.
integrations.a3: Yes, we offer native mobile apps for both iOS and Android. Parents, students, and teachers can access most features on-the-go with real-time notifications.
